checklist.name: correct_keys
checklist.description: Tells the user that Enter submits and Ctrl+J inserts a new line (Esc cancels), not that Esc or Ctrl+D submits.

checklist.name: checks_write_status
checklist.description: Checks `gum write`'s exit status (for example `|| exit 1`) before using the captured text.

checklist.name: confirm_gates_write
checklist.description: Writes the file only when `gum confirm` succeeds.

checklist.name: quotes_variables
checklist.description: Quotes the captured notes when writing them.
